# lebop v0.1.1

## Changes

- Restore notification listing against the current Linear GraphQL schema by
  selecting issue details on the concrete `IssueNotification` type. Other
  notification types keep the existing `issue: null` output shape.
- Fix read-only agent-session detail queries: select external-link labels
  and URLs, and the fields of all six current activity-content variants.
  Existing output normalization and `--no-activities` behavior are retained.
- Fix repeated workspace dossier fetches failing with `EISDIR` while cleaning
  up empty generated directories. Cleanup stays nonrecursive and preserves
  user-owned files.
- Fix the canary MCP smoke closing stdin before asynchronous tool replies
  arrive. Keep stdin open until every request has replied, retain the
  12-second response deadline, and bound process shutdown. Existing payload,
  inventory, manifest, and error checks are unchanged.
- Update `@linear/sdk` 101.1.0 → 103.0.0, Commander 15.0.0 → 15.1.0,
  Biome 2.6.5 → 2.6.8, and Vitest 5.1.0 → 5.1.1. Add an explicit GraphQL
  17.1.0 development dependency for schema-executing regression tests and
  refresh the lockfile and Biome schema.
- Update Bun build, CI, canary, and orb pins to the 1.4.5 security release.
  Node remains 26.13.0. No CLI commands or MCP tools are added; the core/full
  inventories remain 17/103.

## Verification

- The full suite passed 1,438 tests across 87 files on Linux x64 and native
  macOS ARM64. Typecheck, Biome, actionlint, workflow action-reference checks,
  package validation, frozen installation, and dependency audit passed.
- Original notification, session-query, and repeated-fetch failures were
  reproduced before the fixes. Regression tests execute the updated queries
  against a schema, including populated sessions and every activity variant.
  Eighteen MCP lifecycle cases cover asynchronous replies and failure paths.
- Source and compiled Linux x64 each passed 307 live CLI/MCP sandbox checks,
  with zero failures and four existing allowlisted agent-session fixture
  gaps. Discovery completed all 24 steps, including its explicit custom-field
  API-availability gap. Each full run passed 33 destructive-cleanup readbacks;
  independent snapshots confirmed restored active sandbox resources.
- Six real uploads through source, compiled binary, and a fresh npm install
  downloaded byte-for-byte correctly. Attachment records and stored upload
  assets were deleted; authenticated asset reads returned 404 afterwards.
- Four platform binaries passed CLI/MCP smoke checks: native Linux x64 and
  macOS ARM64, Linux ARM64 under QEMU, and macOS x64 under Rosetta. Fresh npm
  and Bun-link installs passed on Linux/macOS. The unchanged binary installer
  passed pinned/latest, checksum, and corruption-rejection checks against
  local HTTPS release fixtures without overwriting an existing installation
  on checksum failure.
- An independent review found no blocking issues. GitHub-hosted native
  builds, live sandbox co-gates, and the published-installer smoke remain
  mandatory release-workflow gates before promotion to latest.

## Known limits

- No populated live agent-session fixture is available. Current-schema and
  populated local CLI/MCP tests pass, but do not replace a live populated
  session fetch. The existing four live fixture gaps expire 2026-12-31.
- Real cycle archival was not attempted without a disposable cycle; the
  existing sandbox cycle and team settings were preserved.
- Custom fields remain an existing public Linear API limitation. This
  release does not add support for fields or mutations absent from that API.
- Local QEMU/Rosetta checks are not native ARM64 Linux/Intel Mac execution.
  Native execution on all four release targets is gated in GitHub Actions.
